info.title: USGS Earthquake Catalog
info.description: The US Geological Survey's public earthquake catalog — global coverage, no key, no account. `quakesNear` is a radius search around a coordinate pair; when `starttime` is omitted the window defaults to the LAST 30 DAYS. `significantQuakes` is the curated feed of significant events this month.

get.summary: Earthquakes within a radius of a coordinate pair (default window: last 30 days)
get.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of earthquakes within `maxradiuskm` of the given latitude/longitude. Each feature carries `properties.mag`, `properties.place` (a human-readable locality), `properties.time` (epoch MILLISECONDS), `properties.url`, and `geometry.coordinates` as [longitude, latitude, depthKm]. Omit `starttime` for the default 30-day window.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the search centre, decimal degrees.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the search centre, decimal degrees.

parameters.name: minmagnitude
parameters.description: Minimum magnitude, e.g. 2.5. Below ~2.5 events are rarely felt.

parameters.name: starttime
parameters.description: ISO8601 date, e.g. 2026-08-01. Omit for the default last-30-days window.

200.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; `features` may be empty — quiet ground is a normal answer.

get.summary: The USGS curated feed of significant earthquakes this month, worldwide
get.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of the month's significant events — same feature shape as quakesNear. No parameters.
